rows.itemTitle: RENEWAL TERMINATION TRANSFER AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION
rows.summary: Item 17 was substantially rewritten: the single-unit initial term dropped from 10 to 5 years, renewal and non-compete terms were shortened, termination and transfer obligations and non-curable defaults were expanded, and the multi-unit development agreement replaced a fixed 27-month term with a schedule-based term while removing the franchisor's right of first refusal.
